title: MixFold: Sub-4-Bit Mixed-Precision LLM Inference via Output-Channel Grouping on Mobile NPUs
abstract: arXiv:2611.26976v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sub-4-bit quantization allows mobile devices to run larger LLMs, but its memory savings do not always translate into faster decoding on mobile NPUs. Their matrix units support only a few native integer datatypes, and converting unsupported weight formats on the vector unit can erase the gains from fewer bits. Mixed precision faces an additional constraint: each matrix-unit tile uses one datatype. MixFold executes 3-bit and perfectly symmetric 2-bit weights using native integer operations without expanding the weights to wider datatypes during decoding. MixFold then assigns datatypes to output-channel groups aligned with the matrix-unit tiles, enabling finer-than-layer assignment without disrupting matrix-unit execution. We compare MixFold with llama.cpp Hexagon backend on the Qualcomm Hexagon NPU of a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5. Across the Qwen3 model family, MixFold achieves comparable or higher accuracy than llama.cpp's sub-4-bit formats

translated_title: MixFold：基于输出通道分组的移动NPU亚4比特混合精度大语言模型推理
translated_abstract: 亚4比特量化使移动设备能够运行更大的大语言模型，但其节省的内存并不总能转化为移动NPU上更快的解码速度。移动NPU的矩阵单元仅支持少数几种原生整数数据类型，而在向量单元上转换不支持的权重格式可能会抵消比特数减少带来的收益。混合精度还面临一个额外的约束：每个矩阵单元瓦片只能使用一种数据类型。MixFold能够在解码过程中不将权重扩展为更宽数据类型的前提下，使用原生整数操作执行3比特和完全对称的2比特权重。MixFold随后将数据类型分配给与矩阵单元瓦片对齐的输出通道组，从而实现比层级别更细粒度的分配，且不会干扰矩阵单元的执行。我们在骁龙8 Elite Gen 5的高通Hexagon NPU上，将MixFold与llama.cpp的Hexagon后端进行比较。在Qwen3模型系列上，MixFold取得了与llama.cpp亚4比特格式相当或更高的准确率。
tldr: MixFold通过将输出通道分组与移动NPU矩阵单元瓦片对齐，无需解码时扩展权重即可原生执行3比特和对称2比特混合精度大语言模型推理，在骁龙Hexagon NPU上实现比llama.cpp相当或更高的准确率与更快的解码速度。
en_tdlr: MixFold enables native 3-bit and symmetric 2-bit mixed-precision LLM inference on mobile NPUs by assigning datatypes to output-channel groups aligned with matrix-unit tiles, avoiding weight expansion during decoding and achieving comparable or higher accuracy than llama.cpp on the Qualcomm Hexagon NPU.
